budgets.title: Har budget me ek thoughtful Celebration.
budgets.body: Ye total hamper budget hai, sirf empty box ki price nahi. Final mix budget, size, availability aur presentation ke hisaab se curate hoga.

products.title: Products nahi, unki pasand se choose karo.
products.body: Har item ki availability selected budget ke hisaab se controlled hai. Locked item par clearly dikhega ki wo kis hamper se available hai.

builder.title: 4 simple steps me apna Celebration hamper banao.
builder.body: Budget rules mix ko automatically safe rakhte hain. Aapko sirf wahi options dikhenge jo selected hamper me fit hote hain.

budget.title: 1. Kitne budget me banana hai?
budget.body: Budget se product eligibility, quantity, packaging aur finishing decide hoti hai.

products.title: 2. Unhe kya pasand aayega?
products.mixExceedsBudget: Ye mix selected hamper budget se bahar ja raha hai

details.title: 3. Thoda personal banate hain
details.body: Required date batana zaroori hai, taaki hum preparation aur delivery feasibility pehle check kar saken.

message: Message card par kya likhna hai

summary.note: Final mix stock, size aur presentation ke hisaab se balance ho sakta hai. Major substitution se pehle aapse confirmation li jayegi.

payment.title: 4. Prepaid payment
payment.body: Payment bank/UPI credit verify hone ke baad hi Paid maana jayega.
payment.setupPending: Business UPI setup abhi pending hai.
payment.successBody: Payment verify hone ke baad order processing start hogi.

promise.title: Har step clear. Har order trackable.
promise.body: Payment se dispatch tak aapko clear process, proof aur order updates milte rahenge.

cta.title: Kisi ke liye kuch special banana hai?
cta.body: Budget choose karo, unki pasand batao aur baaki curation Celebration par chhod do.

tracking.title: Apna Celebration order track karein
tracking.invalid: Ye tracking link invalid ya expired hai.
tracking.lookupBody: Order ID aur order wale phone ke last digits se secure tracking kholen.
tracking.lookupValidation: Order ID aur phone ke required last digits enter karein.
tracking.lookupFailed: Order details match nahi hui. Order ID aur phone digits dobara check karein.
tracking.lookupPrivacy: Security ke liye full phone number yahan show nahi kiya jata.
tracking.approved: Packing dispatch ke liye approved hai.
tracking.approvalTitle: Packing video dekhkar dispatch approve karein
tracking.approvalBody: Video dhyan se check karein. Approval ke baad order courier handover ke liye ready maana jayega.
tracking.approvalConsent: Maine packing video dekh liya hai aur isi packing ke saath dispatch approve karta/karti hoon.
tracking.approvalNote: Approval ke baad team courier aur tracking details add karegi.
tracking.approvalWaitingTitle: Packing approval abhi pending nahi hai
tracking.approvalWaitingBody: Packing video upload hone ke baad yahin approval button active hoga.
tracking.approvalUnavailableBody: Order packing-video-ready stage par aane ke baad yahin se approval diya ja sakega.
tracking.approvedBody: Aapka approval record ho gaya hai. Ab order shipping ke liye ready hai.

admin.title: Celebration Admin
admin.videoTooLarge: Packing video allowed size limit se badi hai.
admin.videoTypeInvalid: Selected video format allowed nahi hai.
admin.shippingNotAvailable: Shipping details customer approval ke baad available hongi.
admin.operationsSubtitle: Payment, packing, approval aur shipping ek hi jagah manage karein.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Order ID, customer, phone, UTR, pincode ya tracking search karein
admin.showingOrders: {total} me se {visible} orders dikh rahe hain
admin.noMatchingOrders: Is search/filter me koi order nahi mila.

nextAction.payment_verification_pending: Bank/UPI credit verify karke payment mark karein.
nextAction.preparing: Packing complete karke video upload karein.
nextAction.packing_video_ready: Customer packing approval ka wait karein.
nextAction.customer_approved: Courier aur tracking save karke order ship karein.
nextAction.shipped: Delivery confirm hone par Delivered mark karein.
nextAction.delivered: Order complete hai; issue window monitor karein.
nextAction.issue_reported: Issue review karke refund/replacement resolve karein.
nextAction.refund_or_replacement_resolved: Issue resolved; koi action pending nahi.
nextAction.cancelled: Order cancelled hai; koi action pending nahi.

admin.cancelConfirm: Is order ko cancel karna hai? Is action ko carefully karein.
admin.waitingCustomerApproval: Video customer approval ke liye ready hai.
admin.videoNeededHint: Dispatch approval se pehle packing video upload karein.
admin.videoUploadedNotice: Packing video uploaded. Customer approval ab pending hai.
admin.shippingReadyHint: Customer approval complete. Courier aur tracking add karein.
admin.shippingUpdateHint: Courier/tracking zarurat ho to update karein.
